scope: Should this rule apply to all products, specific categories, or price ranges?
Does this apply to all customer segments or specific tiers (VIP, new, inactive)?
Should this include international orders or only specific regions?
Are there seasonal or promotional period exceptions?
conditions: What order status or payment method triggers this rule?
Are there minimum/maximum order value thresholds?
Should this consider inventory levels or availability?
Does the customer's purchase history matter?
timeline: Should this apply in real-time or batched (daily, weekly)?
Are there peak/off-peak times when this should/shouldn't apply?
Is there a campaign or promotion date range?
entities: Which tables: orders, customers, products, inventory, or combinations?
Do we need to join payment_methods, shipping_addresses, or promotions?
Should this consider product_variants or just product_ids?
priority: Is this a critical rule (affects revenue) or informational?
How should this interact with existing discount or pricing rules?
impact: How many orders per day would this affect (estimate)?
What's the business value (cost savings, revenue impact)?
Could this create negative customer experiences?
operation: Should orders be excluded from revenue, included, or modified?
Should customers be notified if their orders are affected?
Is this a hard rule (always apply) or soft (best effort)?

scope: Should this apply to all subscription tiers or specific plans?
Does this affect trial accounts, paid accounts, or both?
Should this apply to all regions or specific geographies?
Does churn risk or account age matter?
conditions: What subscription status triggers this (active, paused, at-risk)?
Are there usage-based thresholds (API calls, seat count)?
Should this consider payment renewal date?
Does feature usage or feature adoption matter?
timeline: Should this run continuously or at billing cycles?
Are there quiet hours (don't process at certain times)?
Should this look at historical trends or real-time data?
entities: Which tables: subscriptions, accounts, usage, billing, or features?
Do we need account_admins, team_members, or org_hierarchy?
Should this consider feature_flags or feature_usage?
priority: Is this about retention, upsell, or cost optimization?
How does this prioritize against support or compliance rules?
impact: How many subscriptions per month would this affect?
What's the annual contract value (ACV) impact?
Could this affect Net Revenue Retention (NRR)?
operation: Should accounts be excluded from metrics, included, or flagged?
Should this trigger automated workflows (emails, discounts)?
Is this a hard rule or recommendation?

scope: Should this apply to all support channels (email, chat, phone)?
Does this affect all customer tiers or premium-only customers?
Should this include internal support staff or partner tickets?
conditions: What ticket priority or severity triggers this rule?
Should this consider wait time or response SLA?
Should this look at ticket category or keywords?
timeline: Should this apply 24/7 or business hours only?
entities: Which tables: tickets, customers, agents, teams, or conversations?
Do we need customer_satisfaction_score or support_history?
Should this consider agent_expertise or agent_availability?
priority: Is this about SLA compliance, satisfaction, or cost?
How should this work with existing triage rules?
impact: How many tickets per day would this affect?
What's the impact on first-response time or CSAT?
Could this create bottlenecks or staffing needs?
operation: Should tickets be routed, prioritized, or escalated?
Should this trigger notifications or automations?
Should agents be alerted or is this background processing?

clarification_intent: Is this rule about: filtering data, transforming values, alerting users, or something else?
What's the primary business goal this rule achieves?
Why is this rule needed now?
edge_cases: What should happen with null/missing values?
How should this handle duplicate or inconsistent data?
What's the fallback behavior if conditions can't be evaluated?
dependencies: Does this rule depend on other rules running first?
Are there data freshness or consistency requirements?
Should this rule be evaluated in a specific order?
